summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the monthly net asset value per share for each share class as of July 31, 2026. The filing provides NAV per share figures for six classes, ranging from $11.0598 (Class I-S) to $11.8100 (Class E), along with a breakdown of total NAV of $680.155 million and outstanding shares/units of 59.1 million. This is a routine periodic disclosure required for the non-listed REIT, not a special situation. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist activities, strategic reviews, tenders, going-private transactions, or other special-situation events. The disclosure serves only to inform shareholders of the current NAV, with no structural changes or corporate actions involved.
